BYTE_SEMANTICS: Logical admitted source/evidence charge is defined here prospectively. Submitted buffer suffixes, successful transferred bytes and file/directory durability are separately observed. No transfer or durability inference from admission. Any mandatory separate submitted-operation cap must be bound in supervisor recipe before decision; policy charge alone is not OS cumulative-write enforcement.
CRITICAL_AFTER_DEADLINE: No extra deadline allocation: independently bounded writer finalizes stop evidence within existing campaign3600seconds and protected slots. Deadline expiration is terminal; no new ordinary source writes, no launch authority restoration. If unable to publish, INCOMPLETE external observation; no claimed successful finalization.
NO_RESET: All revisions, static reruns, failed/partial publication and interruption consume original counters. A fresh campaign requires new scoped authority; old allocation never replenishes.
RECOVERABLE: Local syntax, schema, content-identity or static acceptance discrepancy confined to the two new source files, with known effects and unchanged authority/input/history. Manual correction only within remaining admitted counters.
SOURCE_WRITE_POLICY: Pre-admit complete immutable snapshot byte charge; full-snapshot replacement at exact absent-or-last-sealed owned path. A partial write consumes the full reserved charge and one publication; no silent code truncation. Corrections only from sealed checkpoint.
TERMINAL: Wrong authority, path, protected hash, prohibited operation, exhaustion, missing safeguard, or failed entry. Stop.
UNCERTAIN: Unknown write outcome, untracked descendant, uncertain source/store/history effect, missing independent evidence. Stop; do not resume automatically.
